name: CI

on:
  push:
    paths-ignore:
      - .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/**
      - doc/**
      - man/**
      - '**/LICENCE'
      - '**/.gitignore'
      - '**.md'
  pull_request:
    paths-ignore:
      - .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/**
      - doc/**
      - man/**
      - '**/LICENCE'
      - '**/.gitignore'
      - '**.md'
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        cxx: [g++, clang++]
        libc: [glibc]
        include:
          - cxx: g++
            cc: gcc
          - cxx: clang++
            cc: clang
          - libc: glibc
            shell: bash

    defaults:
      run:
        shell: ${{ matrix.shell }}

    steps:
      - name: Set up Ubuntu
        if: matrix.libc == 'glibc'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y autopoint pkgconf gettext libcamera-dev libopencv-dev libavcodec-dev libavdevice-dev libavformat-dev libavutil-dev libswscale-dev libwebp-dev libmicrohttpd-dev libmariadb-dev libasound2-dev libpulse-dev libfftw3-dev

      - name: Checkout source
        uses: actions/checkout@main

      - name: Configure build
        run: |
          autoreconf -fiv
          ./configure CC=${{ matrix.cc }} CXX=${{ matrix.cxx }}

      - name: Build target
        run: |
          ${{ matrix.CXX }} --version
          make -j $(($(nproc)+1))

      - name: Run artifact
        run: |
          file ./src/motion
          ./src/motion -h || true

When is skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs applicable?

Assess skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: Repository policy permits a specific run to be omitted

Contraindications: Strict contract requires all triggers to execute

Method: Treat as behavior-changing rather than a safe default; Require evidence about affected checks

Reported finding: Explicit skipping has limited aggregate impact.

name: CI
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    env:
      MIX_ENV: test
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          # 1.16 is the floor mix.lock permits: multipart requires ~> 1.16.
          # The library itself still supports older, but is not tested there.
          - pair:
              elixir: "1.16"
              otp: "26.2"
          - pair:
              elixir: "1.19"
              otp: "28.1"
            lint: lint
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - uses: erlef/setup-beam@main
        with:
          otp-version: ${{matrix.pair.otp}}
          elixir-version: ${{matrix.pair.elixir}}

      - uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: deps
          key: mix-deps-${{ hashFiles('**/mix.lock') }}

      - run: mix deps.get

      - run: mix format --check-formatted
        if: ${{ matrix.lint }}

      - run: mix deps.unlock --check-unused
        if: ${{ matrix.lint }}

      - run: mix deps.compile

      - run: mix compile --warnings-as-errors
        if: ${{ matrix.lint }}

      - run: mix test
        if: ${{ ! matrix.lint }}

      - run: mix test --warnings-as-errors
        if: ${{ matrix.lint }}
